title: Phase 2: Structured Spec Protocol (lokol exec --spec SPEC.md)
description: Implement parser and bounded state machine for SPEC.md with pre-flight check, target file constraints, and an automated verification gate locking task_finish until exit 0.

title: Phase 1: In-Repo MCP Context Refinery (lokol-mcp)
description: Implement standalone MCP server in cmd/lokol-mcp exposing read_outline, read_window, and test_verifier over JSON-RPC stdio to filter noisy outputs before hitting the model.

title: Epic: Unattended Spec-Driven Autonomous Execution Engine
description: Transform lokol into an unattended autonomous coding engine capable of taking a structured SPEC.md and executing until passing verification within agent-sandbox.
